newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Crucible to float some divisons.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Crucible to float some divisons.

text.p: Industrial ceramics and speciality materials group Morgan Crucible said on Thursday that it plans to float the businesses in its Aerospace, Sensors and Instruments Division.
The new company will be called Emblem Technology.

Morgan Crucible said it does not consider these businesses to be integral to the Company's core business and believes that Emblem Technology will benefit from being able to operate as an independent listed company.
The businesses made sales and operating profits for the year to January 4, 1996 of 36.4 million stg and 4.3 million respectively.
